xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Union of India represented through Commissioner of Central GST, Delhi East
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Show Cause Notice (SCN) dated 08-02-2012 for ₹12.94 million was issued by Commissioner of Central Excise Chandigarh alleging availment of ineligible CENVAT Credit. The Company filed a Writ Petition for quashing of SCN. Hon’ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana allowed Writ Petition vide Order dated 26-11-2019 and quashed the SCN. Union of India represented through Commissioner of Central GST, Delhi East preferred Special Leave Petition (SLP) before Hon’ble Supreme Court of India on 22-12-2020 against the High Court’s Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The matter is pending before Supreme Court. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Central Circle-05, New Delhi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Income tax demand of ₹162.22 million in respect to Assessment Year 2005-06 was raised by the Income Tax Department based on certain grounds related to purchases made by the Company from an overseas vendor. The matter was decided in favour of the Company and the addition of income was deleted by Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) ("CIT (Appeals)"). However, the Income Tax Department has filed an appeal before Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) against the order of CIT (Appeals) which is pending at present.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The appeal before ITAT is pending at present. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Commissioner of Central GST, New Delhi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Demand Order dated 29-01-2015 was issued by the Commissioner of Central Excise, Delhi raising demand of ₹62.50 million with penalty and interest of ₹8.10 million on account of non-payment of service tax u/s 68 on gross value of taxable services. The Company filed an appeal before Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal, Delhi (“CESTAT”) against the said demand order which was allowed by CESTAT. However, Commissioner of Central GST, New Delhi preferred an appeal before the Delhi High Court (“DHC”) on 30-09-2020 which was rejected vide its order dated 10-09-2024. The said Commissioner then filed a Review Petition on 15-11-2024 before DHC against its order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The matter is pending before Delhi High Court. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Central Circle-05, New Delhi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: A search operation was conducted by the Income Tax Department in the premises of the Company in January 2012 and hence the Company had re-filed the income tax returns for the Assessment Year 2006-07 to 2012-13. During the year ended March 31, 2015, the Income Tax Department completed the assessment of the said years, disallowed certain expenses on various grounds including purchases made from overseas party, FCCB raised, payment to overseas party and freebies given to doctors and issued demand of ₹3,294.90 million (including interest). The Company preferred appeals before the CIT (Appeals) against the orders of the Income Tax Department. The appeals were decided in favour of the Company and the demand was cancelled. However, CIT (Appeals) has made certain disallowances with respect to Assessment Year 2010-11 and 2011-12 against which the Company has filed appeals before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT). The Income Tax Department has also filed appeals before ITAT against the orders of CIT (Appeals).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The appeals before ITAT are pending at present. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Central Circle-05, New Delhi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Demand of ₹33.69 million was raised by Income tax department vide its order dated 30-04-2021 on account of disallowance made by transfer pricing officer on purchases from / payment of expenses to, related parties in Assessment Year 2016-17. The Company filed an appeal before ITAT and case was decided in favour of the Company. Department filed an appeal against the ITAT order before Delhi High Court.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The appeal before Delhi High Court is pending at present. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Demand of ₹91.6 million was raised by Income Tax department vide its order dated 10-10-2023 on account of disallowance made by assessing officer in Assessment Year 2020-21. The Company filed an appeal before Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) ("CIT(A)") which was decided against the Company. The Company filed an appeal with ITAT.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The appeal before ITAT is pending at present. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of the Assistant Commissioner of State Tax, GST Bhawan, Mazgaon, Mumbai, Maharashtra
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Earlier, a demand of ₹57.45 million towards balance amount of Goods and Service Tax ("GST") (including interest & penalty thereon) on assignment of leasehold rights in land and building by the Company in Navi Mumbai, was raised by the Office of the Assistant Commissioner of State Tax. The Company had filed Writ Petition in this regard. The Hon’ble Bombay High Court had set aside the said Demand Order and remanded back the matter to the Assistant Commissioner of State Tax, Mumbai for a fresh adjudication on the show cause notice. The Company received a Demand Order dated 10-07-2025 of ₹70.34 million. The Company filed writ petition before the Hon’ble Bombay High Court, challenging the said Order on 04-09-2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Appeal is pending before Hon’ble Bombay High Court. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of the Commissioner, Central GST (Audit) Commissionerate, Punjab
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Show cause notice (SCN) was issued under the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (CGST Act) regarding alleged non-payment of GST of ₹114.40 million on providing Corporate Guarantee amounting to ₹8,640 million to Debenture Trustee viz. Vistra ITCL (India) Limited in relation to transfer of pharmaceutical formulations business to the Company’s wholly owned subsidiary viz. Panacea Biotec Pharma Limited, for 1,074 days from 06-04-2019 to 15-03-2022.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: A writ petition has been filed before the Hon’ble Punjab & Haryana High Court on 05-12-2025, challenging the said Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax, New Delhi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Demand aggregating to ₹93.88 million was raised by Income Tax department vide its three Demand Orders dated 24-12-2025, imposing penalty on account of alleged under reporting of income.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Based on the Company’s assessment, the demands are not maintainable, and the Company is taking all necessary steps including filing an Appeal with appellate authority against the said demands. The Company does not envisage any relevant impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of Assistant Commissioner, Porur, Tamil Nadu
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Demand of ₹8.81 million was raised by GST Department vide its order dated 22-02-2025 in the name of Company's wholly owned subsidiary, Panacea Biotec Pharma Ltd. ("PBPL"), comprising of GST along with interest and penalty thereon, on account of claiming excess input tax credit in its GST returns for the FY 2020-21. PBPL has filed an appeal against the said demand order on 20-05-2025 before the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Tamil Nadu.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The appeal before the Deputy Commissoner of State Tax is pending. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of the State Tax Officer, Mazgaon, Mumbai, Maharashtra
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Demand of ₹15.82 million was raised by GST Department vide its order dated 25-02-2025 in the name of PBPL, comprising of GST along with interest and penalty thereon, on account of claiming excess input tax credit in its GST return for the FY 2020-21. PBPL filed an appeal against the said demand order on 16-05-2025 before the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Maharashtra.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The appeal before the Deputy Commissoner of State Tax is pending. No change during the quarter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of Assistant Commissioner, GST, Porur, Tamil Nadu
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: A Show Cause Notice (SCN) was issued by GST Department in the name of PBPL, with respect to their audit observations alleging liability of ₹8.49 million, comprising of GST along with interest and penalty thereon, on account of claiming excess Input Tax Credit in its GST returns for the FY 2021-22. PBPL filed reply to the SCN on 15-07-2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Matter closed. Order dated 11-12-2025 has been received from Assistant Commissioner of State Tax with Nil demand.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Patna South 2, Patna West Bihar
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: A Show Cause Notice (SCN) was issued by GST Department in the name of PBPL, with respect to their audit observations alleging liability of ₹148.15 million comprising of GST, interest and penalty for various reasons including non-payment of GST under Reverse Charge Mechanism on professional charges paid by PBPL all over India, interest on total sundry creditors, etc.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Matter closed. PBPL filed reply of SCN on 21-11-2025. Order dated 29-12-2025 has been received from Deputy Commissioner of State Tax with Nil demand.
